turn_text: And even with that unemployment rate, though, here on the high line, you see businesses looking for workers and advertising. Why do you think that is? How can that, I guess, look at that unemployment rate in all time low, and a lot of people or businesses still looking for jobs?

That's why during the last legislature, we enacted the M-Tech trades education program. This is a program for small businesses where if they have a promising young person who just or anybody who just may not have the right skills but has the right attitude, the state will pay 50% of the tuition for them to become a carpenter, plumber, machinist, welder, cyber security expert, meat cutter. This is called the M-Tech program.
